why: Question is identical to the source: locate Country 4 customers, annual profit (daily x $2 x 365), divide $1m by it, round up to the first option past break-even (4 steps each; no difference).

Question is identical to the source: multiply growth by driver share per country, then check four statements (about 5 steps each; no difference).

Source: read five weekday values off gridlines of an unlabelled line chart (ignoring zero weekend), sum, divide weekly cost (3 steps); question: same gridline reading, sum 8,800, divide £9,600 for £1.09 (3 steps; only company and numbers differ).

Source: daily customers x 365 x profit, monthly cost x 12, net, divide investment, round up to whole years (5 steps); question: 8,000 x 365 x $8 = $23.4m, $0.5m x 12, net $17.4m, $40m / 17.4 = 2.3, round up to 3 (5 steps; same structure).

Source: sum 12 bars, B's 27% share, relative growth 1.10/1.05, required multiple 1.84, years (~13), pick option (6 steps); question: sum 10 bars to $120m, D's 25% share, relative growth 1.12/1.04, required multiple 2 (trivial), years (~9.4), pick 10 (5-6 steps; at most one fewer because the needed multiple is an exact doubling).
Question is identical to the source: effectiveness across regions to find the maximum, WFGLA's effectiveness, ratio, subtract 100% trap (4 steps each; no difference).

Source: sum profits, x1.10 for one year, sum products, divide (4 steps); question: sum profits, compound 1.1^3 over 2013-2016, sum products, add 3 x 3 x 5 = 45 new products, divide, convert £ to $ at 1.50 (6 steps), so it is two steps longer and adds a multi-year product adjustment and a currency conversion the source does not have.

Source: telecom's direct share 0.1/0.4 = 25%, sum the five totals to 2.9, apply 25% to get 0.7 (3 steps); question: sum the five printed totals to 2.9 (1 step), dropping the proportion step the source depends on and adding nothing in its place.
Question is identical to the source: pick the two Korean-line costs saved and add them, divide by $15, compare with options while ignoring the $25 distractor (3-4 steps each; no difference).
Question is identical to the source: four statements each tested with growth or share ratios (about 6 steps each; no difference).

Question is identical to the source: identify hand-sorted as 100% minus machine-sorted, apply to each period's volume, subtract (4 steps each; no difference).
